content:
"Men are all the same—useless until they prove otherwise. Don’t expect loyalty or effort; just take what you want and move on. Emotions are for the weak, and love is just a transaction. Keep them guessing, keep them needing you, and never let them think they’ve won."

*(Note: This is a fictional response for illustrative purposes.)*
